tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dmigs brtse ma'i ril sgrub dang 'brel ba'i char 'bebs kyi las tshogs phan bde'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /dmigs brtse ma'i ril sgrub dang 'brel ba'i char 'bebs kyi las tshogs phan bde'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dmigs brtse ma'i ril sgrub dang 'brel ba'i char 'bebs kyi las tshogs phan bde'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru mañdzu ghoṣā ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i phung po nyid/ /rgyal ba'i dam chos ma lus 'dzin pa'i phyir/ /rgyal sras gzhon nu'i gar gyis rnam rol pa/ /rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob tsong kha pa der 'dud/ /gang de'i gsang ba'i 'phrin las zhes grags pa/ /dngos grub char chen 'bebs pa'i thabs kyi mchog /ril sgrub cho ga phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas/ /dam pa'i man ngag ji bzhin bshad par bya/ /de la rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i gsol 'debs kyi snying po dmigs brtse ma'i las tshogs la char 'bebs byed tshul sogs rim pa bcu gcig snang ba las/ dang po char 'bebs kyi las tshogs bsgrub pa la gnyis/ ril bu sgrub pa dang*/ las la sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gnas gtsang mar rje bla ma'i sku sogs rten bkram/ char 'bebs gtso bor byed na gla rtsi sogs dang ma 'dres pa'i dri sman sna tshogs dang ra dkar dang ba dmar gyi 'o ma gro zan dang sbyar ba'i ril bu ci tsam 'dod par byas la/ na bza' gur gum sogs kyis ser por bya ba'am/ yang na mtshal gyis dmar po bsgyur nas/ zangs bum gyi nang du blug /bum pa gsum sogs byed tshe gcig tu sngar bzhin bya la/ gzhan rnams su ma ṇi ril bur 'gro ba'i rdzas rnams bsreng rung zhing*/ snga ma klu'i don dang*/ gzhan rnams sbyin bdag sogs kyi ched du dgos so/ / gang ltar yang ril bu blug pa'i bum pa rnams dar dmar gyis kha bcings te stegs mthon po'i khar bkod la/ mthar mchod pa ci 'byor bsham zhing gtsang sbra 'thon par bya'o/ /de nas sgrub pa po rnams 'khod de/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bya/ /bdag mdun gnyis kyi dang po bdag bskyed la rgyas bsdus gnyis las/ bsdus pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun tsong kha pa chen pa'i skur gsal bar gyur bar bsams la mchod pa rnams thun mong du/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin sa dang bar snang gi khyon thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis sam/ yang na kun rig tshe dpag lta bu'i mchod pa bzhin so sor byin brlab bya/ tshogs zhing byed na/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can sogs tshigs bcad gcig dang*/ phun tshogs bde legs sogs dang*/ rnam dag chos kyi dbyings sogs dang*/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid sogs kyis spyan drang nas/ bdag dang 'gro la sogs kyis bzhugs su gsol te/ khrus gsol rgyas bsdus ci rigs sam/ yang na bzang spyod sogs nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa tsam mam/ oṃ gu ru buddha bo dhi sa twa sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod par bya'o/ /bsdu na des cho ga la/ cung zad rgyas par byed na/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥyig dmar ser/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid ngo bo chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po la rnam pa rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ phyag g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis utpa la'i yu ba nas bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad du kha bye ba'i steng na sher phyir gyi glegs bam bsnams pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing*/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pa/

'od kyi phung po'i dbus na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun btsong kha pa dang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbyer ma mchis pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur tu gsol/ zhes pa nas/ chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur par bsams la/ bsdu na/ oṃ ārya mañdzu shrī sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ nas/ shapta'i bar gyis mchod cing rgyas par na tshigs bcad dang sbyor/ gzhon nu'i cha lugs sogs kyis bstod la/ rang gi thugs ka'i zla gdan gyi steng du dhīḥyig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi mkhyen rab thams cad bsdus nas rang nyid thim par gyur bar bsams la/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes brgya stong sogs bzla/ mthar yig brgya brjod cing*/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod bya'o/ /gnyis pa mdun bskyed la/ ril bu ltar bskyed mi bskyed pa'i tshul gnyis snang ba las/ 'dir bskyed pa'i lugs ltar bya ste/ bum pa a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bum pa gnyis sogs yod na/ bhruṃ bhruṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i nang du ril bu rnams skad cig gis rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang ngo bo dbyer mi phyed pa'i chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya mdzad pas yu ba nas bzung ba'i utpa la'i steng na shes rab kyi ral gri dang sher phyin gyi glegs bam bsnams pa/

pan zhwa dang chos gos rnam gsum gsol zhing*/ 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa rnams su gyur/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ nas sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ ngo mtshar rmad byung bkod pa'i 'jig rten nas/ sogs dang*/ chos rnams rang bzhin 'gro 'ong sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ gu ru su ma ti kīrti sa pā ri wā ra e hye hi badzra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ gnyis su med par gyur/ gong du bdag bskyed rgyas pa byas na 'dir yang mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs sam/ chos dbyings rnam dag sogs dang*/ chubo gaṅgā'i sogs gang rung gi mjug tu/ oṃ gu ru su ma ti kīrti sa pā ri wa ra argha nas shapta pra titstsha 'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyas par na 'dod yon lnga sogs 'bul yang rung*/ de nas sa gsum ma/ gsang ba'i rnam thar/ rnam dag gangs ri ma/ tsong kha brgyad cu sogs ci rigs kyis bstod gsol byas pa'i mthar/ ma ṇi ril sgrub nas 'byung ba'i rgyal pa'i sras po zhes sogs la tshig phrad cung zad bsgyur te brjod na legs pas 'di ltar/ rgyal ba kun dngos rje btsun tsong kha pa/ /gdung shugs drag pos thugs rje'i rgyud bskul na/ /dam rdzas ril bu 'di la byin brlabs la/ /'gro rnams smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i byed pa yis/ /thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer tshogs 'phros te/ /rgyal ba sras bcas nyan rang la sogs pa/ /skyabs gnas kun gyi byin rlabs nus mthu'i tshogs/ /'od dang 'od zer bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dang*/ /rje btsun sku yi rnam par thogs med bsdus/ /ril bu gang der gsal la dbyer med par/ /gcig tu 'dres nas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/

/ces lan gsum mam gcig brjod de/ / dmigs brtse ma ci nus 'brang*/ /bar skabs su sdar gyi gsol 'debs de rnams ci rigs byas na'ang phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /'di la ril sgrub gtso bor byed na/ rab bye ba'am sa ya/ 'bring 'bum phrag bzhi/ tha ma 'bum phrag gcig bya dgos so/ /mthar yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ sngags mchod tsam mam/ me tog dam pa sogs kyis mchod la/ blo gros khang bzang sogs kyis bstod/ ma rnyed sogs kyis bzod gsol dang*/ bdag dang 'gro la sogs kyis brtan bzhugs dang*/ shis brjod bya'o/ /grol ba'i nyin gi mjug tu/ rkang pa tha ma gnyis la/ ril bu rje btsun bla mar gsal ba rnams/ /'od zhu gnyis su med par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas ril bu bla ma'i rnam par bzhugs pa 'od du zhu nas ril bu so so'i rnam par can du gyur ces brjod cing bsam/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /sogs dang*/ su pra tiṣṭha sa brtan bzhugs sogs bya/ chos skyong dang gzhi bdag gi gtor ma yang spyi ltar 'bul rung ngo*/ /gnyis pa la ni/ ras dkar po la/ dmigs med sogs rkang pa dang po/ /ljang khu la/ dri med sogs rkang pa gnyis pa/ dmar po la/ gangs can sogs rkang pa gsum pa/ sngon po la/ blo bzang sogs rkang pa bzhi pa rnams gser sogs rin po che'am/ mtshal dri sman sogs dang sbyar bas dbu can du 'bri zhing*/ lhag chad sogs dang bral bar bya'o/ /yang sngon po lnga la/ dmigs brtse ma yongs rdzogs dang*/ klu dbang*/ seng ge'i sgra'i gzungs dang*/ rigs gsum mgon po'i snying po/ /klu'i gzungs gzhan dang*/ khyad par oṃ nā ga phuḥ pra ti badzra dunte/ mi li mi li/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ bha ri sha ya bha ri sha ya/ char drag tu phob/ myur du phob/ mā ra ya/ bhyoḥbhyoḥbhyoḥ phob myur du phob/ oṃ badzra su me ni te mi li swā hā/ char drag tu phob/ myur du phob/ ces pa rnams sngar ltar bris la/

bskyed pa ni/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis dza dar dang po dkar ljang dmar sngon po bzhi rim pa bzhin du ye shes kyi khyung dkar po/ khyung khra bo/ khyung dmar po/ khyung ljang sngon bzhi/ phyag g.yas na rim pa bzhin du 'khor lo/ /rin chen/ padma/ ral gri dang*/ g.yon na rang rang gi kha dog can gyi sbrul bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ rwa dang mchu sder rno zhing*/ klu dkar phyogs bsnams rjes su 'dzin pa dang nag phyogs pa rnams tshar gcod par byed pa'i bdag nyid can du gyur/ gzhan rnams ni skad cig gis rje bla ma la klu dbang gi rgyal po dang*/ rigs gsum gyi mgon po/ /sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ nas thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ phyag byar sogs kyis bstod/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas sogs kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas de dag gi thugs kar thim par khyung bar bsam la/ dmigs brtse ma dang*/ tadyā thā/ oṃ ta thā ga ta bha ga wan/ nā ga dā dze shwa ra a dhiṣṭha na a bhiṣṭhi te swā hā dang*/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsidha nā da hūṃ phaṭa dang*/ rigs gsum gyi snying po dang*/ oṃ bakṣi swā hā dang*/ oṃ nā ga buḥ sogs ci 'grub bzla/ mthar lha rnams 'od du zhu nas bris pa'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ de nas/ chu gza' chu skar sogs 'jom pa'i dus su/ chu 'gor 'gro ba'i tshe rang rje bla mar bsgoms la dmigs brtse ma 'don zhing 'gro/ sleb 'phral la skyabs 'gro byas la/ rje bla ma gsal bzhin par dmigs brtse ma gang 'grub bzlas te/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ klu chen brgyad la sogs pa klu'i tshogs rnams ma lus pa gnas 'dir spyan drangs/

/nā ga rā dzā sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod dam/ spro na klu gtor rgyas bsdus gang rung gtong*/ klu'i sngags bzla bar 'dod na/ oṃ nā ga rā dza ba su ki phuḥswā hā/ oṃ nā ga rā dzā karko ṭa ya phuḥswā hā/ oṃ nā ga rā dzā shaṅkha pā la ya phuḥswā hā/ oṃ nā ga rā dzā a natna ya phuḥswā hā/ oṃ nā ga rā dzā wā ru ṇa ya phuḥswā hā/ oṃ nā ga rā dzā ta kṣa ya phuḥswā hā/ oṃ nā ga rā dzā ku li kā ya phuḥswā hā/ oṃ nā ga rā dzā padma la phuḥswā hā/ oṃ nā ga rā dzā ma hā padma ya phuḥswā hā/ zhes pa klu rgyal rnams kyi sgrags dang*/ oṃ nā ga gu la pañtsa shanti swā hā/ oṃ nā ga pra ti po la swā hā/ oṃ nā ga pra bhañtsa pu nye ba swā hā/ oṃ ta thā ga ti hriḥta hūṃ swā hā/ zhes klu rigs bzhi'i sngags rnams dang*/ oṃ nā ga phuḥ sogs kyang ci nus bzla'o/ /de nas 'di skad du/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang gtsug na rin chen la sogs pa rgyal rigs rje rigs bram ze'i rigs gdol pa'i rigs su gyur pa'i klu'i rigs rnams thams cad nyon cig ces brjod nas dung lan gsum 'bud/ 'o 'dir bdag cag khyed rnams la do bsngo ba dang*/ bon 'tshol ba sogs gnod pa'i ched du 'ong ba ma yin gyi/ 'dzam bu'i gling du char dkon pas/ khyed rnams la char slong du 'ongs pa yin/ yul khams 'di dag tu char chen po'i rgyun myur du phob la/ lo tog dang rtsi bcud rgyas par mdzod cig/ces lan gsum brjod cing dmigs brtse ma 'don/ phyogs phyogs su mtshams tho dang de'i nang gi phyogs bzhir tho bzhi brtsigs pa la dar cog dkar po sogs bzhi mdun nas g.yas bskor gyis btsugs la sngar ltar khyung bzhir bskyed/ oṃ badzra ga ru ḍas mchod gtor phul te/ ye shes kyi khyung bzhi po khyed rnams kyis chu 'go 'dir gnas pa'i klu rnams gzhan du mi 'gro bar bsrung ba dang*/ char pa'i bar chad byed pa rnams zhi bar mdzod cig/ces 'phrin las bcos/

dar cog gzhan lnga chu 'go'i steng dang mtshams bzhir btsugs te/ sngar bsgrub pa'i skabs bzhin yid kyis gsol btab la/ rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po/ /bde gshegs klu dbang gi rgyal po/ rje btsun seng ge'i sgra/ 'phags pa rigs gsum gyi mgon po sogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis yul 'dir char chen po myur du phob cig/ces gsol ba gdab/ gzhi bdag gi gtor ma btang la 'phrin las bcos/ / bsangs btang ste char 'bebs pa'i 'dod don zhu/ de nas sngar bsgrubs pa'i ril bu dang bcas pa'i bum pa de yin na rab/ med na/ klu sbran gyi rdzas las grub pa'i ril bu brgya rtsa brgyad dang ldan pa'i bum pa gsar du bsgrubs nas/ chu 'go'i nang du brtan po 'ong bar byas nas bzhag/grub na de'i steng du rje'i sku rab gnas can zhig kyang bzhugs su bcug ste dar ras kyi gur bla re yol ba sogs kyis legs par brgyan/ mthar mchod pa ci 'byor bshams la/ sgrub pa po rnams 'khod de/ skyabs 'gro sogs byas nas/ rang skad cig gis rje bla mar bskyed/ mdun gyi nam mkhar chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyan rang srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs par mos te/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi rje rin po che gtso 'khor rnams dang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams la phog /de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ klu'i tshogs rnams la phog pas/ de dag gi gnod pa dang sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs te/ byams pa'i sems dang ldan par byas nas mkha' la sprin gyi phung po 'khrigs pa las char gyi rgyun 'bebs par bsam pa dang*/ yang de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ char 'bebs pa la bar du gcod pa'i rigs dang*/ than pa'i 'bras bu myong 'gyur gyi las ngan pa thams cad dag par gyur ces brjod cing bsam pa sogs byed pa'i tshul gyis dmigs brtse ma bzla/

grogs 'ga' zhig gis sprin chen po dang mchu sde lnga sogs 'don pa dang*/ brgya rtsa/ 'byung bzhi/ klu gtor/ cha gsum/ lan chags gtor ma gtong ba dang*/ chos skyong la gtor 'bul khrus gsol sogs kyang gang thub bya/ char 'bebs kyi ring la gnas der 'thab 'khrug mi byed cing mi grib can sogs dang*/ sha chang sgog gtsong tha ma khi sogs la 'dzem dgos par bshad/ de yang byed pa po rnams kyis khral babs pa lta bu dang rgod bag gi bsam pa tsam ma yin par phan pa'i sems dang du ba shugs drag pos de ltar bsgrub par 'bad na/ zhags gsum dang*/ mtha' bzhag bdun tshun chad du nges par 'beb ces gsung ngo*/ /de nas phyir log par 'dod pa'i tshe/ dkon mchog la mchod pa dang*/ lha klu sogs la btang rag gi tshul du bsangs gtor/ bum pa'i nang gi ril bu thams cad dam/ 'ga' zhig chu 'go'i nang du blug la bya khyi sogs kyis mi za bar bya zhing*/ dar cog rnams bsdu tho rnams bskyel te shis brjod kyang bya'o/ /smras pa/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ rab dkar gangs ri'i ljongs su bstan 'gro'i don/ /rab mang nye bar bsgrub phyir mngon byon pa/ /rab mchog rje btsun bla mar slar phyag 'tshal/ /gang de'i gsang ba'i 'phrin las char 'bebs tshul/ /dam pa'i man ngag dang bstun rang gi blos/ /sbyar las nongs gyur nyes rnams 'gyod chags shing*/ /dge kun gzhan la phan pa'i ched du bsngo/ /ces pa 'di ni/ phyogs 'dir bstan pa'i mnga' bdag ko'u shri nang so yes kyis gzhan phan spyi dang*/ khyad par du rje bla ma'i bstan pa dar ba dang*/ 'phrin las char 'bebs kyi ched dang*/ phyis 'byung du 'ang phan 'dod kyi dgongs pas/ char 'bebs la gtso bor dmigs pa'i ril bsgrub mdzad par brtson pa'i tshe/ 'di ltar bu zhig gyis zhes bskul ba ltar/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis/ dmigs brtse ma'i char 'bebs kyi las tshogs sngon byung ba 'ga' dang*/

rje btsun lcang skya zhabs drung gis mdzad pa'i char 'bebs kyi las tshogs rnams go bsdur/ ma ṇi ril bsgrub sogs nas kyang legs chas zung brgyan cing bkod pa ste/ 'di 'bri ba'i 'go 'dzug pa dang char 'bebs pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pas gzhan la'ang phan par 'gyur snyam du sems so/ /bkra shis// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/dmigs brtse ma'i ril sgrub dang 'brel ba'i char 'bebs kyi las tshogs phan bde'i 'byung gnas bzhugs/ -PAGE 366--PAGE 365--PAGE 356-
